name: Faris Ruknuddin
headline: Systems Architect · Applied AI & Cybersecurity Engineer
intro: Final-year B.E. student in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at AITM in Bhatkal (Class of 2027). Founder & Chief System Analyst at Omnimate. I engineer tamper-evident digital forensics, AST-based static code security auditors, resilient computer vision controllers, and local-first data systems.
security_focus: I am deeply focused on Cybersecurity—specializing in Application Security (AppSec), Static Analysis (SAST), Digital Forensics, and Cryptographic Audit Trails. I am actively learning and excelling in ethical hacking, offensive/defensive methodologies, vulnerability research, and zero-trust systems architecture.
experience: **Omnimate · Founder & Chief System Analyst (Mar 2026–present).** Led a 7-person cross-functional engineering team delivering client software; architected the Omnimate Shots screenshot ingestion & search API.
**Smart India Hackathon 2026 · Team HackHive (SIH26188).** Designed and architected ID-SHIELD, an explainable identity & multi-document forensics platform with cryptographic audit logs.
**MR Tech Industries · Software Engineering Intern (Aug–Oct 2026).** Developed retail and mall services management systems.
**Hadi and Taimur AI · AI Intern (Feb–May 2026).** Built data extraction microservices and automated content scheduling pipelines.
**MyJobGrow · Cloud Infrastructure Intern (Feb–May 2025).** Deployed, monitored, and automated applications across AWS and GCP with CI/CD.
**Acmegrade · AI/ML Intern (Oct 2024–Jan 2025).** Trained and optimized predictive analytics and classification models.
